name: Fujiidera (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Fujiidera city emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Fujiidera, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 June 1965.

features.role: Fujiidera city emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised character
